data.exact_reserve_text:
This has resulted in gross reserves of GBP 138.3m, GBP 39.2m net of reinsurance, included in the financial results for the year ended 31 December 2022. The two classes potentially impacted are Aviation Reinsurance and Aviation War. The loss reserve is split 93% to the 2021 year of account and 7% to the 2022 year of account.
The most significant movement in claims during the last 12 months impacting the 2020 and prior years was an influx of lawsuits related to Florida construction defects. ... The total of additional reserves added to the prior years for claims notified or IBNR related to this issue amounts to $27.0m net in the calendar year.
specific_events: Russian invasion of Ukraine (including western leased aircraft in Russia)

prior_year_events.impact_description: Influx of lawsuits related to Florida construction defects caused significant deterioration on a book of contractors' general liability business written between 2014 and 2019; additional reserves added to prior years for notified claims or IBNR amount to $27.0m net in the calendar year.

Probabilistic modelling resulted in gross indirect reserves of GBP 138.3m (GBP 39.2m net) included in the 2022 financial results, split 93% to 2021 year of account and 7% to 2022 year of account (primarily impacting Aviation Reinsurance and Aviation War).
Deterioration on the Boeing loss increased the syndicate's loss (net of reinsurance recoveries) from $5.8m to $7.9m, impacting Aviation Reinsurance accounts (2019 year of account).
Deterioration on the Naga 7 loss with the reserve now $10.0m net to Atrium, largely falling into the 2020 year of account (impacts Marine and Energy Liability accounts).
Hurricane Laura totalled $35.4m gross and $19.5m net of reinsurance recoveries split between 2019 and 2020 years; the loss has not deteriorated materially during the year.
The ultimate claims from COVID-19 are now expected to be $71.0m, with the majority falling to the 2019 and prior years; significant IBNR remains.

named_events.loss_description: Estimated ultimate loss to Atrium is $35.8m gross and $32.3m net of reinsurance recoveries; affected property classes writing in North America.
Direct losses reserved amount to GBP 21.1m gross and GBP 8.7m net; indirect losses (notably western leased aircraft in Russia) reserved at GBP 138.3m gross and GBP 39.2m net included in 2022 results.
Totalled $35.4m gross and $19.5m net of reinsurance recoveries; split between 2019 and 2020 years.
Deterioration now reserved at $10.0m net to Atrium, largely falling into the 2020 year of account.
Deterioration increased the net loss to Atrium from $5.8m to $7.9m (affects Aviation Reinsurance account for 2019 year of account).

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 789.8m. During 2022 there was a material gross strengthening of prior years of approximately GBP 139.7m, driven predominantly by the syndicate's provisioning for indirect losses arising from the Russian invasion of Ukraine (gross indirect reserves of GBP 138.3m, of which 93% were allocated to the 2021 year of account) together with other adverse developments on prior years (notably deterioration on certain casualty portfolios and legacy large losses). The movement represents a portfolio-wide adverse development (strengthening), with casualty and aviation/reinsurance lines most affected. Some prior-year items such as Florida contractors litigation were quantified on a net basis in the report but gross figures were not disclosed.
raw_causal_phrases: This has resulted in gross reserves of GBP 138.3m, GBP 39.2m net of reinsurance, included in the financial results for the year ended 31 December 2022.
The loss reserve is split 93% to the 2021 year of account and 7% to the 2022 year of account.
The most significant movement in claims during the last 12 months impacting the 2020 and prior years was an influx of lawsuits related to Florida construction defects.
The total of additional reserves added to the prior years for claims notified or IBNR related to this issue amounts to $27.0m net in the calendar year.
There was also a significant deterioration on the Boeing loss during 2022 which impacts the Aviation Reinsurance account for the 2019 year of account.
The Naga 7 loss ... is now reserved at $10.0m net to Atrium.
Direct losses reserved for amount to GBP 21.1m gross and GBP 8.7m net of reinsurance as at 31 December 2022.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was calculated by combining (a) the explicitly stated gross indirect reserves of GBP 138.3m (93% allocated to 2021 YOA  gross strengthening  GBP 128.619m) which are explicitly disclosed in the report, with (b) the gross movement derived from the published gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2013-2020 (+GBP 11.071m). Some specific reserve impacts are quoted only on a net (post-reinsurance) basis or in USD in narrative (e.g. Florida construction defects $27.0m net, Hurricane Ian $35.8m gross/$32.3m net in USD); those USD/net figures were NOT converted to the report currency or used as gross amounts. Gross prior-year movement therefore reflects the major disclosed gross strengthening item (Ukraine aircraft) plus the triangle-derived movement for older years. Where only net amounts or USD amounts were provided, gross equivalents were not available and so are left null. The claims triangle excludes the aggregated '2012 & prior' column by design.
